listing.name: Heroes of Might and Magic II (fheroes2)
listing.summary: Play Heroes of Might and Magic II with the fheroes2 engine and your own game resources.
listing.original_game_title: Heroes of Might and Magic II

steps.title: Finish the supported Windows resource setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use a permitted complete fheroes2 Windows copy with its matching libraries and your own supported Heroes of Might and Magic II resources, or a demo you are separately permitted to use. The Windows ZIP instructions require upstream resource extraction or the documented manual ANIM/DATA/MAPS/MUSIC copy before normal play. The Linux Flatpak first-start resource picker is a different route. Portcove does not run the extraction BAT, acquire demo/original assets or install Windows redistributables for this prepared-copy route. Select native fheroes2.exe after setup.

steps.title: Retain the actual resource and profile search paths
steps.instruction: Keep the creating working directory, complete runtime/resources and all original/custom maps and music. Windows profile selection checks an existing HOME environment first, using HOME/.fheroes2, then APPDATA/fheroes2, with an SDL preference fallback. Preserve the actual creating account/environment and selected config/data directories rather than assuming AppData is always used; Portcove does not inject environment variables. Keep fheroes2.cfg, the full data/profile tree including files/save, saves, custom files and unknowns. Do not force a new portable profile or treat the missing-resource error window as an original-data picker. Finish setup with upstream’s tools and start and quit the intended copy before registering it. Keep the creating version and actual data locations recoverable when replacing an external copy.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. Engine licensing does not grant rights to original game assets, music, mods or bundled components.
Before updating the game, keep a copy of its working files and every location containing saved data. Choosing a different executable does not give it a separate profile.

data_locations: the actual external fheroes2 profile and the original and custom resources of your prepared copy

preparation.title: Copy your Heroes II resources to the personal fheroes2 folder before Play
preparation.instruction: Create %HOME%/.fheroes2 if HOME points to an absolute personal folder, or %APPDATA%/fheroes2 if HOME is unset and APPDATA points to an absolute personal folder. Use a separately prepared copy if neither applies. Copy ANIM, DATA, MAPS and MUSIC from your own supported Heroes of Might and Magic II installation when present. Keep the directories and original files together. Use the same Windows account and environment for setup and Play. Keep originals out of the managed game folder.

warnings: The Windows x64 ZIP may need the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable linked by upstream. Portcove runs no bundled resource, demo or prerequisite installer.

Keep a separate backup of the actual external fheroes2 profile, including files/save, settings and custom maps. Use a separately prepared copy for custom profile or resource locations. Real save compatibility across versions remains unverified.
